description: The IoT Edge Blue-Green Deployment Strategy project aims to implement a robust deployment framework that allows for seamless updates of IoT Edge applications without any downtime. This strategy involves maintaining two identical environments, referred to as 'blue' and 'green.' The current version of the application runs in one environment while the new version is deployed in the other. Once the new version is tested and verified, traffic is switched from the old version to the new one, ensuring a smooth transition. This approach minimizes risks associated with application updates, enhances operational efficiency, and provides a rollback option in case of issues. The project will include thorough documentation, testing protocols, and a detailed deployment plan to ensure that the transition is as seamless as possible, ultimately improving the reliability and performance of IoT Edge applications.
